schema.title: Model budget
schema.hint: Per pipeline stage, per run. A stage that hits a limit stops and asks you.

fields.label: Token budget per stage
fields.hint: Tokens a single stage run may use before it stops.

fields.label: Count cache reads
fields.hint: Off: only new tokens (uncached input + output) count. On: every re-sent context token counts, which exhausts long stages quickly.

fields.label: Cost budget per stage
fields.hint: Estimated API spend a single stage run may reach before it stops.

schema.title: New job defaults
schema.hint: Applied when a job is created without its own value (the New job form prefills them).

fields.label: Repair retries
fields.hint: Automatic re-attempts after a failed stage.

fields.label: Job cost limit
fields.hint: Total spend for the whole job. Blank = no job-level limit (stage budgets still apply).

fields.label: Job runtime limit
fields.hint: Wall-clock limit for the whole job. Blank = none.

fields.label: Acceptance review
fields.hint: Run the extra acceptance-criteria reviewer (env MUCLI_JOBS_ACCEPTANCE_REVIEW still forces it on).

schema.title: Agent iterations
schema.hint: How many agent loop turns a stage may take. A job's own limit wins.

fields.label: Default iterations per stage
fields.hint: Applies to every stage without a more specific limit.

fields.label: Plan stage iterations
fields.hint: Blank = default above.

fields.label: Implement stage iterations
fields.hint: Blank = default above.

fields.label: Review stage iterations
fields.hint: Blank = default above.

schema.title: Stage time limits
schema.hint: Wall-clock limit for each sandboxed stage; reaching it pauses the job.

fields.label: Model request timeout
fields.hint: How long one model call from inside the sandbox may take.

fields.label: Automatic fix attempts
fields.hint: Times a check failure is sent back to the implementer before a human is asked.

fields.label: Baseline triage
fields.hint: Re-run failing checks on the base commit; failures that also happen there are reported, not sent back to the implementer.

fields.label: Validation command timeout
fields.hint: Per-command limit for host-run validation commands (legacy verifier).

fields.label: Required check suites
fields.hint: Added to every job's plan checks. Commands run in the sandboxed checks stage.

schema.title: Toolchains
schema.hint: Per-repository build environments (planos-style). A matching repository's implement and checks stages run in an image derived from its base image (mucli adds Python + its agent code); the derived image is built on first use or with Build.

fields.label: Repository toolchain images
fields.hint: Base image = an image that already has the project's toolchain, e.g. the project's builder/CI image or rust:1.88. Add the package registries the build needs (crates.io, static.crates.io, index.crates.io, pypi.org …) to Extra egress domains.

schema.title: Sandbox
schema.hint: The locked-down container each stage runs in.

fields.label: Runtime image
fields.hint: Local image; it is never pulled.

fields.label: Memory limit
fields.hint: Docker memory value, e.g. 8g or 16384m.

fields.label: Largest changed file
fields.hint: Changes with a bigger file are rejected.

fields.label: Extra egress domains
fields.hint: Domains implement and checks may reach in addition to the model relay, e.g. pypi.org or *.npmjs.org.

fields.label: Push timeout
fields.hint: Limit for git push and the PR/MR request.

fields.label: Publish mode
fields.hint: Used when a job does not set its own mode.

schema.title: Automatic retries
schema.hint: Transient provider failures are retried with exponential backoff.

fields.label: First retry delay
fields.hint: Doubles on every further attempt.

fields.label: Longest retry delay
fields.hint: Cap for the doubling delay.

schema.title: Scheduling & retention
schema.hint: How the job controller runs and cleans up work.

fields.label: Concurrent jobs
fields.hint: Jobs that may run a stage at the same time.

fields.label: Base drift check interval
fields.hint: How often finished jobs are checked against their base branch. 0 = off.

fields.label: Archive retention
fields.hint: Artifacts of archived jobs older than this are purged. 0 = keep forever (env MUCLI_JOBS_RETENTION_DAYS wins when set).
